root_cause_label: Agent installed only git without openssh-server and never created the required 'user' account, making the SSH-based git clone command impossible
one_sentence_failure_summary: The agent never installed openssh-server or created the 'user' account required by the task's git clone command, leaving the SSH-based git workflow non-functional despite correctly setting up the bare repo and post-receive hook.
t_err_evidence: Step 1 plan specifies only 'apt-get install git' without openssh-server; the agent assumes git alone is sufficient, ignoring that 'user@localhost:/git/server' requires an SSH daemon and a 'user' system account.
t_commit_evidence: After step 2, only git (and openssh-client as a dependency) is installed; no SSH server daemon is present. The agent moves forward to repository setup without ever reconsidering the missing SSH service or user, locking in the failure.
trigger_explanation: The task specification implicitly requires SSH server and a 'user' system account (evidenced by the git clone command 'user@localhost:/git/server'). The agent never read or acted on this requirement, focusing only on git repository structure and the web server, and never attempted to install openssh-server or adduser.
